name: Zombie, Emu
body:
Undead Emu
CR 1

The following creature was created by applying the Zombie template to the emu created by Spes Magna Games.

XP 400
NE Medium undead
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 16 (3d8)
Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +3
Defensive Abilities DR 5/slashing; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee slam +3 (1d6+1)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 14, Con –, Int –, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +2; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Toughness
SQ staggered

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Staggered (Ex)

Zombies have poor reflexes and can only perform a single move action or standard action each round. A zombie can move up to its speed and attack in the same round as a charge action.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization any
Treasure none
